ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (EXEMPTION) RULES 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 66(1)(x) and 127(1)(b) of

the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Road Transport (Exemption)

Rules 2023.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 29 March 2023.

Exemption

2. The Minister exempts persons specified in column (1) of the Schedule from

the application of the provisions specified in column (2) of the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

(1)

Persons to whom Exemption Applies

(2)

Provisions

Any person granted a motor vehicle licence

granted under section 16 of the Act

Subsection 20(1) of the Act

Rule 18 of the Motor Vehicles

(Registration and Licensing) Rules 1959

[L.N. 173/1959]

Any person granted a driving license

under section 27 of the Act

Subsections 52(2) and 52(4) of the Act

Subsection 58(2) of the Act

Rule 12 of the Motor Vehicles

(Driving License) Rules 1992

[P.U. (A) 409/1992]

Any person granted a vocational license

under sections 56 and 57 of the Act

Subsections 52(2) and 52(4) of the Act

Subsection 58(2) of the Act

Rules 15A of the Public Service Vehicles

(Licensing and Conduct of Drivers,

Conductors and Passengers) Rules 1959

[L.N. 177/1959]

Made 24 March 2023
